description: Search Target.com products, browse a department, look up exact item numbers, paste a Target URL, or fetch trending deals — with prices, sale/clearance flags, ratings, UPC/DPCI, category breadcrumbs and product details.

inStockOnly.description: Exclude products Target reports as out of stock. Search, department and deals listings that carry no stock signal are kept and marked `UNKNOWN` unless full-detail enrichment resolves them.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeDetails.description: Fetch each product page to add description, UPC/DPCI, category breadcrumbs, specifications, review counts and the online stock status Target publishes.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full product details

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000). Target exposes up to 50 pages of 24 results per query.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages to request per query (1–50; 24 products per page).
maxPages.title: Max pages

maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this price.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this price.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minRating.description: Drop products with an average rating below this value (0–5).
minRating.title: Min rating

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products currently marked on sale or clearance.
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

query.description: Keyword to search for (mode=search). E.g. 'iPhone case'.
query.title: Search query

tcins.description: One or more Target item numbers (TCINs), e.g. '94715153'. Comma-separated strings are also accepted.
tcins.title: Target item numbers (mode=byTcin)

url.description: A Target product, category, brand or search URL. E.g. 'https://www.target.com/p/item/-/A-12345678'.
url.title: Target URL (mode=byUrl)

title: Target Product Scraper Input
